issues: Bacterial/microbiological indicator ranges are compound qualitative+numeric expressions (e.g. 'не обнаружено/(0,3-9,9x10^9) КОЕ/100 см3'); the entire expression was kept in range_from with range_to/unit set to null since it does not fit a clean from-to-unit split. Row 3 (formaldehyde, ПНД Ф 14.1:2:4.84-96) and the source document's row labeled '19' for МУК 4.2.3695-21 (soil, appearing twice with duplicate row numbering in the original PDF, likely a numbering typo in the source) were each split into multiple JSON rows to represent per-object or per-sub-range values. No ТР ТС / раздел section headings are present anywhere in this document (only lab address headings), so tr_section is null on every row per the rules. No rotated or illegible pages encountered.
